title: Committee of Supply debate on Ministry of Home Affairs Head P
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head P of the Estimates for the Ministry of Home Affairs, opened by a proposed $100 reduction and followed by Members' speeches and ministerial responses.
stage: Committee of Supply (Head P of the Estimates)
why_it_matters: The debate covers Home Team policies on terrorism, cyberattacks, drugs, scams, rehabilitation, fire safety and road safety. The transcript states specific changes including extending Fire Certificate validity from one year to three years from 1 April 2026, planning to bring RHA measures into force by end-2026, and amending FICA to allow anticipatory directions against online communications.

key_points.point: Mr Vikram Nair moved to reduce the total sum allocated for Head P of the Estimates by $100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head P of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: He said Singapore's threat environment is more complex than ever and hostile actors exploit new technologies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: Our threat environment is more complex than it has ever been.

key_points.point: He cited ISD figures that at least eight self-radicalised Singaporeans were dealt with under the ISA between July 2024 and July 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: between July 2024 and July 2025, at least eight self-radicalised Singaporeans were dealt with under the Internal Security Act (ISA).

key_points.point: He said 17 youths aged 20 and below have been dealt with under the ISA since 2015, with more than two-thirds in the last five years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: 17 youths aged 20 and below have been dealt with under the ISA since 2015, with more than two-thirds in the last five years

key_points.point: He said a 17-year-old far-right extremist supporter used an AI chatbot to look for instructions on producing ammunition.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: a 17-year-old far-right extremist supporter used an AI chatbot to look for instructions on the production of ammunition

key_points.point: He cited CSA figures showing phishing attempts reported rose from 4,100 in 2023 to 6,100 in 2024, a 49% increase.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: phishing attempts reported to the CSA increased from 4,100 in 2023 to 6,100 in 2024, an increase of 49%.

key_points.point: He said drug abusers arrested rose from 3,175 in 2024 to 3,208 in 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: the number of drug abusers arrested increased modestly from 3,175 in 2024 to 3,208 in 2025.

key_points.point: He said total amount lost to scams and cybercrime rose to at least $1.1 billion in 2024, up from $651.8 million in 2023.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: in 2024, the total amount lost to scams and cybercrime rose to at least $1.1 billion, up from $651.8 million in 2023.

key_points.point: He asked whether the Ministry plans to collect data on the mental health status of individuals arrested for drug-related offences.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
key_points.quote: does the Ministry plan to collect data on the mental health status of individuals arrested for drug-related offences?

key_points.point: He asked whether MHA will review laws such as the Registration of Criminals Act, including whether some records can be spent earlier.
key_points.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
key_points.quote: will the Ministry consider reviewing laws such as the Registration of Criminals Act, including whether some records can be spent earlier where appropriate

key_points.point: He asked what MHA's medium-term quantitative targets are for reducing five-year recidivism over the next five years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gabriel Lam
key_points.quote: what is MHA's medium-term quantitative targets for reducing five-year recidivism over the next five years?

key_points.point: She asked which ASEAN jurisdictions have not yet joined FRONTIER+ and what the impediments are.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: Among ASEAN countries, which jurisdictions have not yet joined FRONTIER+ and what are the impediments?

key_points.point: She asked for the Ministry's assessment of OCHA's effectiveness in preventing scams.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: What is the Ministry's assessment of its effectiveness in preventing scams?

key_points.point: He asked what plans the Government has to work with the private sector to fight scams more effectively.
key_points.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
key_points.quote: What are the plans that the Government have to work with the private sector to fight scams more effectively?

key_points.point: She asked how Singapore can further strengthen its regulatory frameworks to provide more tools to combat scams.
key_points.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng
key_points.quote: how can we further strengthen our regulatory frameworks, to provide more tools to combat scams?

key_points.point: He said scam cases decreased by 27.6% or 14,193 cases in 2025 from 2024.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yeo
key_points.quote: In 2025, the number of scam cases decreased by 27.6% or 14,193 cases from 2024.

key_points.point: He said the Anti-Scam Command recovered $140.5 million worth of scam losses in 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yeo
key_points.quote: In 2025, the Anti-Scam Command successfully recovered $140.5 million worth of scam losses.

key_points.point: He invited the Minister to share if there are plans to expand the FRONTIER+ grouping.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alex Yeo
key_points.quote: if there are plans to the expand the FRONTIER+ grouping

key_points.point: She asked whether maximum sentences should be raised to give courts flexibility for different levels of culpability.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: whether we should raise maximum sentences to allow our courts further flexibility to address different levels of culpability

key_points.point: He asked for an update on AI products developed under the Home Team AI Movement.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sanjeev Kumar Tiwari
key_points.quote: Could the Ministry update on the AI products developed so far under this movement?

key_points.point: She said unattended cooking remains one of the leading causes of residential fires in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
key_points.quote: unattended cooking remains one of the leading causes of residential fires in Singapore

key_points.point: He asked what lessons MHA has drawn from the Wang Fuk Court fire in Hong Kong.
key_points.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng
key_points.quote: what lessons has MHA drawn from this tragic fire in Hong Kong?

key_points.point: He asked how to educate and equip the population to discern online influence attempts.
key_points.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng
key_points.quote: how do we educate, inoculate, vaccinate, whatever terms that we want to use, to really equip our population

key_points.point: He said Singapore politics must remain the domain of Singaporeans.
key_points.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
key_points.quote: Singapore politics must remain the domain of Singaporeans.

key_points.point: He said Singapore's stance must continue to be one of zero tolerance towards drugs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
key_points.quote: Singapore's stance must continue to be one of zero tolerance towards drugs.

key_points.point: He said 1,165 new drug abusers were arrested in 2025, a 17% increase, and one in two was below 30.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jackson Lam
key_points.quote: In 2025, 1,165 new drug abusers were arrested.

key_points.point: He asked whether the Ministry intends to recalibrate preventive outreach and engage children earlier.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jackson Lam
key_points.quote: does the Ministry intend to recalibrate its preventive outreach?

key_points.point: He said Singapore was ranked the world's safest country for the 12th time in Gallup's 2025 Global Safety Report.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: Singapore was ranked the world's safest country for the 12th time

key_points.point: He said MHA will designate race-based entities assessed to have higher potential of being vectors for malicious foreign interference.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: we will be designating race-based entities that are assessed to have higher potential of being vectors for malicious foreign interference.

key_points.point: He said MHA plans to bring the Maintenance of Racial Harmony Act, including these measures, into force by end-2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: My Ministry is planning to bring RHA, including these measures, into force by end-2026.

key_points.point: He said MHA will amend FICA to allow anticipatory directions against online communications that may be used for hostile information campaigns.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: We will therefore amend FICA, so that our legislation can be more effective against such threats.

key_points.point: He said SCDF will extend Fire Certificate validity from one year to three years effective 1 April 2026, with annual inspections retained.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) will extend the validity of FCs from one year to three years, effective from 1 April 2026.

key_points.point: He said HDB's Enhancement for Active Seniors programme provides subsidies of up to 95% for Home Fire Alarm Devices, with seniors paying as little as $6.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
key_points.quote: we provide subsidies of up to 95% for HFADs, with seniors paying as little as $6 out of pocket.

key_points.point: He said CNB employs measures to tackle online drug trafficking and there is no safe haven for offenders.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: there is no safe haven for them, because CNB employs a slew of measures or strategies to tackle online drug trafficking.

key_points.point: He said a Singaporean involved in a drug trafficking syndicate in Thailand was issued a detention order under the CLTPA on 22 September last year.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: 22 September last year, he was issued a detention order under the Criminal Law Act (CLTPA) in view of his involvement in drug trafficking activities.

key_points.point: He said many messages peddling soft drugs on platforms such as Telegram are scams where buyers do not receive the promised products.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: these are not really drug offers but actually it is a scam whereby potential clients, after making payment do not and will not actually receive the products that are promised to them.

key_points.point: She asked how MHA arrived at the revised threshold of 15 micrograms of alcohol per 100 millilitres of breath and how it intends to enforce it.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: I am wondering how MHA arrived at that revised threshold and how MHA intends to enforce this.

key_points.point: She said the current alcohol limits have been in place since 1985 and studies show impairment can happen at levels lower than current prescribed limits.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
key_points.quote: The alcohol limits that are currently enforced have been in place since 1985

key_points.point: She said MHA agrees it must be sensitive to varied needs of the population and will deploy technology sensitively.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
key_points.quote: We agree with Ms Sylvia Lim that we have to be very sensitive to the varied needs of our population.

key_points.point: He asked how often the Yellow Ribbon employment ecosystem review is done.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gabriel Lam
key_points.quote: how often is that review done?

key_points.point: He said MHA looks at process and effectiveness, not just number of employers, and trains employers and inmates.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: we not only look at the numbers of the employers that work with us, we look at the process and the effectiveness of the efforts being undertaken

key_points.point: He asked whether outcomes are tracked to assess whether inmates with mental health conditions have higher recidivism rates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
key_points.quote: whether outcomes are tracked to assess whether those with mental health conditions have higher recidivism rates compared to the general inmate population.

key_points.point: He said the prison has a strong support system and customises rehabilitation for each person.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: we have a strong support system in the prison where we not only look after them, we customise their rehab process.

key_points.point: He asked whether MHA is considering simplified processes so recovered scam amounts can be returned to victims more expeditiously.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: is MHA considering having some simplified processes so that amounts recovered from scams can be returned to victims more expeditiously?

key_points.point: He said it is MHA and SPF priority to return funds as quickly as possible, but tracing is complex and assets may be commingled.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: it is MHA and SPF priority to try and return the funds as quickly as possible.

key_points.point: He said 15 grams of diamorphine feeds 180 drug abuses for one week.
key_points.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
key_points.quote: 15 grams of diamorphine feeds 180 drug abuses for one week.

key_points.point: He agreed more statistics can be used in drug education.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
key_points.quote: We certainly agree with you that we can use more statistics on this.

key_points.point: She asked whether penalties can remain proportionate and whether there will be continued education and support for vocational drivers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
key_points.quote: will the Ministry also consider how penalties can remain proportionate and whether there will be continued avenues for education and support

key_points.point: He withdrew his proposed cut in support of the Budget.
key_points.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
key_points.quote: in support of the Budget, I will be withdrawing my cut.

what_happens_next: Mr Vikram Nair withdrew his proposed $100 cut; MHA plans to bring RHA measures into force by end-2026, SCDF will extend FC validity from 1 April 2026, and a refreshed SGSecure campaign will launch next week.
